status: English benchmark drafts; terminology hints require reviewer judgment, not exact-match scoring.

samples.name: Barbell bench press
samples.instructions: Keep your shoulder blades together and lower the bar under control. Do not bounce the bar off your chest.

samples.name: Incline dumbbell press
samples.instructions: Keep your wrists stable. Lower both dumbbells evenly; do not raise your shoulders towards your ears.

samples.name: Machine chest press
samples.instructions: This is a chest exercise, not an overhead shoulder press. Keep your back against the backrest while pressing the handles forward.

samples.name: Machine shoulder press
samples.instructions: Press the handles overhead without arching your lower back. This is a shoulder exercise, not a chest press.

samples.name: Lat pulldown
samples.instructions: Pull the handle towards your upper chest. Do not pull it behind your neck or swing your torso.

samples.name: Seated cable row
samples.instructions: Pull your elbows back and bring your shoulder blades together. Keep your torso stable rather than leaning back.

samples.name: Face pull
samples.instructions: Pull the rope towards your face with a controlled movement. Keep your shoulders down and do not shrug.

samples.name: Romanian deadlift
samples.instructions: Push your hips back with a slight bend in your knees. Keep the bar close to your legs and avoid rounding your lower back.

samples.name: Conventional deadlift
samples.instructions: Start with the bar on the floor and keep it close to your body. Stand up without leaning backwards at the top.

samples.name: Bulgarian split squat
samples.instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench and keep your front foot planted. Lower yourself under control; complete both sides.

samples.name: Goblet squat
samples.instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest. Keep your heels on the floor and let your knees follow the direction of your toes.

samples.name: Barbell hip thrust
samples.instructions: Support your upper back on a bench and lift your hips. Pause for 1 second at the top without overextending your lower back.

samples.name: Glute bridge
samples.instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on the floor. Raise your hips by contracting your glutes, without arching your lower back.

samples.name: Hammer curl
samples.instructions: Keep your palms facing each other throughout the movement. Bend your elbows without swinging your torso.

samples.name: Reverse curl
samples.instructions: Use a palms-down grip and keep your elbows near your torso. Move smoothly and avoid bending your wrists.

samples.name: Rope triceps pushdown
samples.instructions: Keep your upper arms near your sides. Extend your elbows and slightly separate the rope ends at the bottom.

samples.name: Forearm plank
samples.instructions: Support yourself on your forearms and toes. Keep your body in a straight line for 30 seconds and continue breathing.

samples.name: Side plank
samples.instructions: Support yourself on one forearm and the side of your foot. Do not let your hips drop. Hold for 20 seconds on each side.

samples.name: Pallof press
samples.instructions: Stand sideways to a cable or resistance band. Press your hands forward without allowing your torso to rotate.

samples.name: Farmer's carry
samples.instructions: Carry a dumbbell in each hand for 30 seconds. Stay upright and maintain a firm grip without shrugging your shoulders.
